name: axion-ia-unified
description: Monorepo Unificado Axion IA - Panel + API + Engine
author: Axion Tecnologia

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "PANEL,API,ENGINE" -c "cyan,green,magenta" "npm run dev:panel" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:engine"
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd panel && npm install && cd ../api && npm install && cd ../engine && npm install
scripts.clean: rimraf panel/node_modules panel/dist api/node_modules engine/node_modules node_modules
